summary: Applied three blocking spec review repairs: explicit review phase history scope, normalized finding identity/category contract, and flow.json retry state as an attempt-limit input.

items.title: Review history scope omits existing review phases
items.rationale: Expanded the included review phases to impl, spec, test, draft-questions, and draft-coverage, listed latest artifact basenames, and pinned the history filename pattern.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in[2], scope.in[4], requirements R3/R4, clarification, alternative, and task T-2 now define the included phases and history path.

items.title: Finding identity and category contract is missing
items.rationale: Added a normalized finding record requirement with stable id, phase, source artifact, attempt, severity, title/body, category, and explicit unknown fallback.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R3/R5/R8], acceptance criteria, implementation targets, and tasks T-3/T-4/T-5 now define normalized finding ids and categories.

items.title: Attempt-limit source misses review retry state
items.rationale: Added flow.json retry metrics as an input for attempt-limit detection so review retry exhaustion is not dependent on manual issue-log entries.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in[1], overview.data_flow, overview.decisions, requirements[R2], acceptance criteria, and tasks T-4/T-5 now reference flow.json retry state.
